about: The conflict check's pins (tests/plugin/rule-conflicts.test.js): sentences matching each pattern in the head system prompt and in an MTF-arm cycle prompt (no briefing) with the mtf-entry skill, pinned at today's exact counts. A count may only go down (a raise is a review finding); the cycle's one never-counter match is the precedence paragraph's list of arm D rules (a fence, not a rule).
